description: Tiny REST API for managing todos - smoke test for Ralph-RLM using TypeScript, Express, and Vitest

features.description: Bootstrap Node.js project with TypeScript, Express app factory, entry point, and smoke test
acceptance_criteria: package.json has typescript, express, vitest, and supertest dependencies
tsconfig.json compiles TypeScript to JavaScript
Express app exported as factory so tests import without starting a listener
src/index.ts starts the server on a port
npm scripts: build, test are defined
Unit test: app.test.ts > 'app boots without error' verifies the app can be imported
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)
features.notes: Foundation for all other features. Also creates tsconfig.json.

features.description: Add GET /health endpoint returning 200 with JSON health status
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns HTTP 200
Response body is JSON with a field indicating the service is healthy
Unit test: health.test.ts > 'GET /health returns 200' verifies status code
Unit test: health.test.ts > 'GET /health returns JSON health status' verifies body
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)

features.description: Define TodoItem interface and in-memory store with add, getAll, getById helpers
features.source_requirement: ## Functional Requirements > ### 3. Create and list todos
acceptance_criteria: TodoItem type has id, title, completed, createdAt, and updatedAt fields
In-memory store supports add, getAll, and getById operations
New items default completed to false and set createdAt/updatedAt
Unit test: store.test.ts > 'add returns an item with all required fields' verifies model shape
Unit test: store.test.ts > 'getAll returns items in insertion order' verifies ordering
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)
features.notes: F002 and F003 are independent and can run in parallel.

features.description: Add POST /todos and GET /todos endpoints for creating and listing items
features.source_requirement: ## Functional Requirements > ### 3. Create and list todos
acceptance_criteria: POST /todos with valid title creates an item and returns 201 with the created item
GET /todos returns 200 with an array of all items in creation order
Created items have id, title, completed=false, createdAt, and updatedAt
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'POST /todos creates an item' verifies creation
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'GET /todos returns all items' verifies listing
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)
features.notes: Registers todos routes in the Express app.

features.description: Add GET /todos/:id endpoint returning a single item or 404
features.source_requirement: ## Functional Requirements > ### 4. Read a single todo
acceptance_criteria: GET /todos/:id returns 200 with the item when it exists
GET /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error details when item does not exist
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'GET /todos/:id returns the item' verifies success
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'GET /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id' verifies not-found
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)

features.description: Add PATCH /todos/:id endpoint to update title and/or completed status
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /todos/:id updates title and/or completed and returns 200 with updated item
updatedAt changes when an update succeeds
PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error for unknown id
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'PATCH /todos/:id updates the item' verifies update
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id' verifies not-found
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)
features.notes: F005, F006, F007 depend on F004 but are independent of each other.

features.description: Add DELETE /todos/:id endpoint removing the item and returning 204
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /todos/:id returns 204 on success
DELETE /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error for unknown id
Deleted item no longer appears in GET /todos or GET /todos/:id
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'DELETE /todos/:id removes the item' verifies deletion
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'DELETE /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id' verifies not-found
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)

features.description: Add input validation returning 400 for missing/blank title on POST and invalid payloads on PATCH
features.source_requirement: ## Functional Requirements > ### 7. Validation and error handling
acceptance_criteria: POST /todos with missing title returns 400 with JSON error
POST /todos with blank title returns 400 with JSON error
PATCH /todos/:id with empty title returns 400 with JSON error
PATCH /todos/:id with wrong data types returns 400 with JSON error
All error responses are JSON with descriptive messages
Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'POST /todos rejects missing title' verifies validation
Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'PATCH /todos/:id rejects invalid payload' verifies validation
Build passes (npm run build)
Tests pass (npm test)
features.notes: Depends on F006 because PATCH validation tests need the update endpoint.
